main_text.head: PARS SECVNDA.
EX SCRIPTVRIS PROBANTVR AFFIRMATIVA Fidei nostræ Capita.
CAP. I.

p.i: Exponuntur capita Fidei nostræ affirmativa, quotquot præcipua & maxime necessaria sunt.

main_text.p: E D hæc quidem hactenus dicta satis esse videntur ad vindicandos à Methodicorum importunitate, atque tyrannide sensus, animosque nostros, & ad solvendas tristes, & contumeliosas catenas, quibus eos homines amentissimi per summam injuriam vincire, ac constringere nequicquam conantur. Nunc ad institutam fidei nostræ demonstrationem veniamus; & ea, quæ credimus atque confitemur, primo universa breviter & quantum satis est, exponamus; tum singula legitime ex Scriptu-ris
[The initial letter is a woodcut historiated initial "N" (or similar), not transcribed as text.]

page.notes: The opening word "E D" is printed as "Ed" with a small d-like abbreviation; read as printed. The large woodcut initial at the start of the paragraph is a historiated letter; its likely letter is uncertain. The title band is a decorative ornament, not text. The subtitle is italic and centred, treated as a second-level heading in the text layout. Line "ris" at the end of the paragraph is the completion of "Scriptu-ris" set apart on the right.
